ResearchProjectDef.label: basic farming
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop basic crop tending practices. Historical horizon: broad evidence places early cultivation roughly between 8000 and 5000 BCE; this is not a precise invention date.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal husbandry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Improve animal care and breeding practices. Historical horizon: evidence for early domestication spans roughly 9000 to 5000 BCE and varies by region.

ResearchProjectDef.label: seed selection
ResearchProjectDef.description: Select and preserve useful seed stock. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; practices developed gradually and varied by region.

ResearchProjectDef.label: grain storage
ResearchProjectDef.description: Protect grain against damp and pests. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; storage practices developed gradually with agriculture.

ResearchProjectDef.label: food drying
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish controlled natural drying to preserve meat and selected vegetables. Drying is an ancient preservation practice, not a first invention date.

ResearchProjectDef.label: salt preservation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish a reliable local process for preserving selected meat, fish, and vegetables with salt. Salted foods keep the remaining freshness of their original ingredients; this represents local mastery, not the first invention of salting.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sealed pottery storage
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop reliable sealing and storage practices for pottery vessels. Pottery storage is ancient; this represents a dependable local method, not the invention of pottery vessels.

ResearchProjectDef.label: food smoking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish a reliable wood-fired smoking process for preserving ordinary meat and, when available, fish. Smoking is an ancient practice; this represents local mastery, not its first invention.

ResearchProjectDef.label: food fermentation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish controlled fermentation for selected vegetables. Fermentation is an ancient practice; this project represents a reliable local process, not its first invention.

ResearchProjectDef.label: irrigation channels
ResearchProjectDef.description: Plan simple channels and water control. Early irrigation has a broad possible horizon around 4000 BCE; dates differ by region and this is not an invention date.

ResearchProjectDef.label: water management
ResearchProjectDef.description: Coordinate channels, wells, and local drainage. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; water management developed gradually in many regions.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rammed earth construction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop compacted earth building methods. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; earthen construction has a long, regionally varied history.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bronze alloying
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop repeatable copper alloy batches. Broad archaeological horizons for early bronze metallurgy fall roughly between 2200 and 1700 BCE; regional dates vary.

ResearchProjectDef.label: early ironworking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study small-scale bloomery iron working. Proposed early horizons range broadly from about 1200 to 500 BCE and remain disputed by region; this is not a precise invention date.

li.HistoricalDescription: Scenario simulation window only; the timing and regional history of early ironworking remain disputed.

ResearchProjectDef.label: iron farm tools
ResearchProjectDef.description: Adapt early iron stock to agricultural tools. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; adoption depended on regional ironworking and available evidence.

li.HistoricalDescription: Scenario simulation window only; regional adoption of iron agricultural tools is not assigned a single invention date.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bronze casting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop controlled mould casting. Broad archaeological evidence places early bronze casting roughly between 2000 and 1700 BCE; regional dates vary.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bronze tools
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop practical bronze implements. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; tool forms and adoption dates varied by region.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pottery
ResearchProjectDef.description: Shape and fire clay vessels. Pottery has a very broad prehistoric horizon, with evidence predating roughly 10000 BCE in some regions; local traditions arose at different times.

ResearchProjectDef.label: kiln firing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Improve control over enclosed clay firing. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; kiln forms and firing practices developed at different times by region.

ResearchProjectDef.label: record keeping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop durable local records. No single reliable emergence year is assigned to record keeping; writing systems arose independently at different times.

ResearchProjectDef.label: regional exchange
ResearchProjectDef.description: Organize regional goods and craft knowledge exchange. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; exchange networks grew gradually and varied by region.

ResearchProjectDef.label: plant fibre preparation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Prepare suitable fibres for cordage and cloth. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; perishable materials leave an incomplete archaeological record.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bow making
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop consistent simple bow construction. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; organic materials preserve poorly and early dates vary by region.

ResearchProjectDef.label: weaving
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop a simple woven textile process. No single reliable emergence year is assigned; textile evidence is limited and regional practices differ.
